basis: Ecclesiastes is treated as a framed wisdom discourse whose genuine units are title, poem, first-person investigation, observation chain, saying sequence, counsel movement, enjoyment conclusion, and epilogue. Chapter numbers, famous-verse extraction, a fixed gloss for hebel, speaker/editor reconstruction, later canonical reuse, and theological harmonization are never boundary authority.
proposal_bias: Prefer the larger coherent discourse movement; preserve exact parents whenever an internal seam is disputed; keep enjoyment conclusions with the investigation or observation they answer; lower confidence for voice, versification, translation, judgment, mortality, gender, royal, and frame hot zones.

chunks.deciding_marker: The nominal book/speech heading identifies Qohelet and precedes the repeated hebel declaration at 1:2.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not absorb the heading silently into a chapter fallback or use royal/lineage language to prove authorship.
chunks.premortem_risk: Qohelet, gender, royal designation, narrator, and autobiographical identity could be converted into authorship or editor claims.
chunks.hold: Speaker, gender, title translation, royal persona, authorship, and frame relation remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The emphatic hebel opening governs a patterned catalogue of generations, sun, wind, streams, weariness, seeing, hearing, recurrence, and forgotten memory, closing before the first-person royal investigation at 1:12.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize 1:2 as a slogan, fix hebel to one English abstraction, or split the natural cycles into isolated prooftexts.
chunks.premortem_risk: A famous opening line, a single hebel gloss, or an imposed cosmology could displace the complete poem.
chunks.hold: Hebel, yitron, recurrence, cosmological description, and voice relation to 1:1 remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: First-person royal self-location and the formula of setting the heart to seek introduce the investigation; its wisdom-and-grief conclusion closes before the pleasure test at 2:1.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not make the English chapter boundary the investigation's terminus or infer a historical king from the persona.
chunks.premortem_risk: Royal/autobiographical authorship and a fixed reading of crookedness or striving could dictate the seam.
chunks.hold: Royal persona, authorship, chronology, and difficult idioms remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The self-addressed pleasure test expands through a governed catalogue of wine, projects, property, wealth, singers, greatness, and desire, then closes with retrospective evaluation in 2:11.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not fragment the achievement list or treat palace details as sufficient historical autobiography.
chunks.premortem_risk: Catalog items may be atomized, moralized individually, or used to identify an author and date.
chunks.hold: Historical referent, moral evaluation, hebel/yitron translation, and experiment boundaries remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The turn to compare wisdom, madness, and folly develops a light/dark advantage but reaches the shared fate and hatred-of-life conclusion at 2:17.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not harmonize the qualified advantage of wisdom with the common-death conclusion or detach 2:17 as a despair prooftext.
chunks.premortem_risk: Apparent contradiction may be flattened into a system, and mortality language may be made into afterlife doctrine.
chunks.hold: Wisdom's relative advantage, mortality, memory, and theological implications remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Hatred of toil initiates the inheritance and sleepless-labor reflection; the eating, drinking, work, gift, wisdom, and gathering conclusion answers the investigation through 2:26.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 2:24-26 as a free-standing enjoyment doctrine or sever it from the toil problem it concludes.
chunks.premortem_risk: The enjoyment refrain could be isolated, harmonized with later refrains, or made into a universal reward system.
chunks.hold: Gift, divine agency, sinner/good-person categories, enjoyment theology, and refrain relation remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A governing declaration of a season and time introduces fourteen balanced time pairs; the poem closes with peace before the work question resumes at 3:9.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize individual pairs as commands, promises, or event predictions.
chunks.premortem_risk: Famous pairs may be prooftexted, moralized, or converted into deterministic chronology.
chunks.hold: Relation of the pairs to divine action, ethics, providence, and chronology remains deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The yitron/work question answers the time poem through task, appropriate time, hidden totality, enjoyment, gift, enduring action, fear, recurrence, and pursuit before the injustice observation at 3:16.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not extract 3:11 or 3:12-13 as doctrinal slogans, and do not let one gloss of the difficult 3:11 expression decide the unit.
chunks.premortem_risk: Translation of 3:11, systematic providence, or enjoyment theology could erase the question-and-answer movement.
chunks.hold: 3:11 translation, divine action, fear, recurrence, and enjoyment implications remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The 'I saw' injustice observation moves through judgment, human/animal mortality, disputed spirit direction, and a concluding work/portion statement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split 3:21 into an afterlife prooftext or harmonize the mortality observation with a predetermined doctrine.
chunks.premortem_risk: 3:21 translation and fear/judgment/afterlife theology may dictate seams or preferred readings.
chunks.hold: Judgment, human-animal comparison, spirit direction, afterlife, and portion theology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A renewed 'I returned and saw' introduces oppression, power, absent comfort, and a threefold comparison of living, dead, and unborn.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the living/dead/unborn comparison into a universal life or death doctrine.
chunks.premortem_risk: Trauma, suicide, pessimism, or theodicy readings could suppress the bounded oppression observation.
chunks.hold: Ethics, pastoral application, theodicy, and life/death valuation remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A toil-and-skill observation attributes rivalry, answers with the fool's folded hands, and closes with the one-handful/two-handful comparison.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate individual proverbs from the rivalry/rest comparison or universalize one labor ethic.
chunks.premortem_risk: Short sayings may be atomized or forced into a single economic or ascetic doctrine.
chunks.hold: Rivalry, labor ethics, rest, and folly implications remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Another 'I returned and saw' presents the solitary worker's unanswered 'for whom?' question, followed by the coherent two-are-better chain and threefold-cord closure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the cord image as a marriage formula or strip it from the loneliness/toil problem.
chunks.premortem_risk: A famous companionship verse may be prooftexted, while number symbolism or later use may be made seam authority.
chunks.hold: Social setting, marriage application, numerical rhetoric, and relation to toil remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The better-than comparison introduces poor wise youth, old foolish king, prison/kingdom reversal, crowds, succession, and later dissatisfaction as one political observation.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify the figures with historical rulers or reconstruct a chronology as boundary proof.
chunks.premortem_risk: Ambiguous pronouns and succession may invite speculative royal identifications, authorship, or dating.
chunks.hold: Referents, syntax, royal history, chronology, and political application remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Approach to God's house governs listening, speech, dreams, vows, messenger, and fear; the admonition remains coherent across the English/MT numbering pressure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split at the English chapter seam, prefer one numbering system, or detach vow verses from guarded worship speech.
chunks.premortem_risk: WEB/MT offset, messenger translation, worship law, and fear theology could dictate a preferred numbering or doctrinal unit.
chunks.hold: Versification mapping, messenger identity, vow law, dream language, and fear theology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Oppression is located within layered official oversight, then love of money, increasing consumers, spectator wealth, and worker/rich sleep form a compact power-and-wealth chain.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate hierarchy or money maxims from their linked wealth observation or infer a specific imperial bureaucracy.
chunks.premortem_risk: Political chronology, economic doctrine, or proverbial atomization could replace the local argument.
chunks.hold: Administrative referent, political setting, wealth ethics, and sleep comparison remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A grievous wealth case moves from hoarding and loss to naked departure and dark consumption, then closes with a seeing/recognizing enjoyment, gift, portion, and occupied-heart conclusion.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 5:18-20 as an uncomplicated prosperity doctrine or sever it from wealth loss and mortality.
chunks.premortem_risk: Enjoyment may be detached from the grievous case, or gift/wealth language converted into a universal reward theology.
chunks.hold: Gift, portion, divine agency, joy, wealth ethics, and mortality remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A named grievous evil tests wealth, honor, longevity, descendants, denied enjoyment, stranger consumption, and the stillborn comparison through the shared destination at 6:6.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not treat the chapter start as a new topic without relation to 5:13-20 or extract the stillbirth image from the wealth/enjoyment argument.
chunks.premortem_risk: Trauma, disability, prosperity, or afterlife claims may override the rhetorical comparison.
chunks.hold: Stillbirth ethics, death destination, divine agency, wealth, and enjoyment remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Mouth/appetite, wise/fool advantage, seeing desire, naming and contending, multiplied words, fleeting days, and ignorance of what follows form the question-driven close to the wealth/appetite movement.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split rhetorical questions into settled answers or use the chapter end as sufficient closure by itself.
chunks.premortem_risk: Ambiguous syntax and rhetorical questions may be prematurely resolved into anthropology or determinism.
chunks.hold: Appetite, advantage, naming, stronger-one language, human good, and future ignorance remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A sustained better-than chain links name/death, mourning, rebuke, patience, nostalgia, wisdom, and preservation, then closes by holding prosperity and adversity together under unsearchable divine action.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize the better sayings, extract 7:1 or 7:10, or force each comparison into an absolute command.
chunks.premortem_risk: Famous sayings, funeral ethics, nostalgia, prosperity, and divine causality may be made independent doctrines.
chunks.hold: Better-than rhetoric, death/mourning ethics, divine causality, and adversity theology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Observed righteous perishing and wicked prolonging lead to disputed warnings against excess, the fear-of-God hinge, wisdom strength, universal failure, and counsel not to attend to every word.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 7:16-18 as a moderation slogan, anti-righteousness doctrine, or contradiction to other wisdom texts.
chunks.premortem_risk: Translation, irony, righteousness theology, fear theology, and contradiction harmonization could decide the seam or meaning.
chunks.hold: 7:16-18 syntax and force, righteousness/wickedness, fear, sin, and counsel remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The first-person wisdom test and repeated finding/not-finding language govern the inaccessible-depth question, bitter-woman imagery, one-among-a-thousand count, and the concluding upright-human/many-schemes finding.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 7:26-28 into a universal gender verdict, biographical confession, or fixed anthropology.
chunks.premortem_risk: Gendered rhetoric, rare syntax, speaker biography, misogynistic reception, or harmonization may overwhelm the search movement.
chunks.hold: Gender, referent, ethics, syntax, creation language, and human-schemes theology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The wisdom question moves into king-command counsel, oath, departure, royal word, time/judgment, ignorance, spirit/death, and one-person's power over another, closing with the explicit reflective summary at 8:9.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not turn royal counsel into absolute political obedience, identify a historical monarch, or detach the power-to-harm conclusion.
chunks.premortem_risk: Royal history, political theology, oath translation, and apparent contradiction may dictate an authoritative reading.
chunks.hold: King identity, obedience ethics, oath, spirit, death, time/judgment, and political application remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The difficult burial/holy-place observation leads to delayed sentence, emboldened evil, fear/retribution sayings, reversed outcomes, and an explicit commendation-of-enjoyment response at 8:15.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not choose a preferred 8:10 reading, harmonize the retribution claims, or detach 8:15 from the injustice puzzle.
chunks.premortem_risk: Textual/translation difficulty, fear/judgment theology, contradiction harmonization, and enjoyment prooftexting converge here.
chunks.hold: 8:10 text/translation, delayed judgment, fear, retribution, and enjoyment theology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A renewed setting-the-heart formula examines ceaseless human activity and closes with the repeated inability to find out God's work, even under wisdom claims.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not use the chapter ending alone as authority or turn epistemic limits into a complete doctrine of revelation.
chunks.premortem_risk: Theological system-building or chapter fallback may erase the small but formally explicit conclusion.
chunks.hold: Scope of human knowing, divine work, wisdom claims, and relation to the preceding puzzle remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: A heart-applied observation places righteous and wise in God's hand, develops one fate and living/dead contrasts, then turns to eating, love, clothing, companionship, and wholehearted work before the grave/Sheol closure.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not detach 9:5, 9:7-10, or Sheol language into afterlife, sacrament, marriage, labor, or divine-approval prooftexts.
chunks.premortem_risk: Afterlife theology, famous-verse extraction, enjoyment detachment, and contradiction harmonization could fracture the common-fate response.
chunks.hold: Love/hate, divine hand/approval, living/dead knowledge, Sheol, enjoyment, marriage, and labor remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The renewed 'I returned and saw' catalogue denies predictable success to speed, strength, wisdom, understanding, and skill, then closes with fish/bird snare images of sudden evil time.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 'time and chance' into determinism, randomness theology, or a chronology claim.
chunks.premortem_risk: Chance, providence, merit, and sudden-death theology may be forced into a systematic resolution.
chunks.hold: Chance, time, divine agency, merit, and mortality remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: An explicitly introduced wisdom example narrates a small city, great king, siege, poor wise deliverer, and forgotten wisdom, followed by paired conclusions about quiet wisdom, weapons, and one sinner.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify the city, king, or wise person historically, or detach the concluding sayings from the example.
chunks.premortem_risk: Gender/number translation, historical identification, political allegory, or proverb atomization could distort the story.
chunks.hold: Textual gender/number, historicity, referents, memory, wisdom, and sinner language remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: The dead-fly image governs small folly outweighing wisdom, heart/road exposure, composure before a ruler, and an observed governmental error of fools exalted and servants/rulers reversed.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split every proverb or infer a specific court crisis and chronology.
chunks.premortem_risk: Rare idiom, political history, class ethics, and isolated proverbs may create false seams.
chunks.hold: Heart/right-left idiom, ruler counsel, political setting, status ethics, and chronology remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Pit, wall, stone, wood, and blunt-iron risks form a skill sequence that turns to snake/charmer, gracious/foolish speech, multiplying words, future ignorance, and exhausting labor.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not atomize work hazards into unrelated maxims or turn one image into a guaranteed cause-and-effect law.
chunks.premortem_risk: Proverbial atomization, lexical obscurity, occupational reconstruction, and simplistic retribution may override the chain.
chunks.hold: Idioms, occupational setting, speech ethics, future knowledge, and foolishness remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Woe/blessing contrasts for land and rulers introduce feasting time, lazy roof, feast/wine/money sayings, and a closing warning about cursing ruler or rich person in private.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify rulers historically, universalize money's answer, or isolate the bird-of-the-air image as surveillance doctrine.
chunks.premortem_risk: Royal chronology, class politics, money theology, censorship, or famous sayings could dictate interpretation.
chunks.hold: Ruler age/status, feast timing, money idiom, private speech ethics, and political setting remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Bread-on-waters and seven/eight counsel lead through disaster risk, rain/tree limits, wind-watching paralysis, hidden life/work of God, and morning/evening sowing under uncertainty.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not reduce 11:1 to charity, trade, investment, or resurrection certainty, and do not atomize the agricultural images.
chunks.premortem_risk: Famous-verse prooftexting, economic reconstruction, numerology, and providence theology may dictate seams.
chunks.hold: Bread/waters meaning, seven/eight function, embryology image, divine work, risk, and diligence remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Light's sweetness and many dark days introduce youth rejoicing under judgment, removal/transition counsel, the imperative to remember the creator, and a sustained aging/death image sequence that closes by repeating the opening hebel formula.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not split at the English chapter seam, extract 11:9 or 12:1, decode every aging image with certainty, or turn judgment into a complete doctrinal system.
chunks.premortem_risk: Chapter fallback, famous verses, textual/translation difficulty, allegorical anatomy, youth ethics, and afterlife/judgment theology converge here.
chunks.hold: Youth imperatives, judgment, creator/creators reading, aging imagery, dust/spirit, death, and hebel closure remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

chunks.deciding_marker: Third-person evaluation of Qohelet's wisdom, teaching, weighing, arranging, and truth introduces goad/nail imagery, a warning about books/study, and the explicit 'end of the matter' fear/command/judgment close.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not assign the voice to a hypothetical editor as fact, detach 12:13-14 as a correction, or harmonize the book by making the epilogue erase the discourse.
chunks.premortem_risk: Voice/editor hypothesis, canon defense, fear/judgment theology, authorship, chronology, and contradiction harmonization may decide the seam.
chunks.hold: Epilogue speaker, editorial relation, authorship, canon/reception history, fear, commandments, judgment, and hidden things remain deferred_human_or_external_ai.

premortem_holds.risk: Chapter boundaries survive as disguised fallback units.
premortem_holds.appeal: Require positive local form and closure for every boundary; preserve the cross-chapter 5:1-7 and 11:7-12:8 movements.

premortem_holds.risk: Hebel is assigned one fixed English gloss and made the controlling theology.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain the framing recurrence as evidence while routing lexical range and local force to qualified Hebrew/translation review.

premortem_holds.risk: Royal persona, Qohelet, first-person discourse, and third-person epilogue are turned into a settled author/editor reconstruction.
premortem_holds.appeal: Use observable voice/form shifts only; keep identity, authorship, dating, and redaction deferred.

premortem_holds.risk: Enjoyment refrains are detached as slogans or flattened into one systematic doctrine.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep each enjoyment conclusion attached to its local toil, time, wealth, injustice, or mortality problem; record larger exact parents.

premortem_holds.risk: Famous verses are extracted and allowed to dictate doctrine or seams.
premortem_holds.appeal: Retain poems, saying chains, mortality/enjoyment movements, youth/aging poem, and epilogue as their governing contexts.

premortem_holds.risk: Fear, judgment, mortality, spirit, Sheol, or afterlife language is forced into a harmonized theological system.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep local questions and tensions visible, select no reading, and route doctrine to qualified human or external review.

premortem_holds.risk: Royal or political observations are mapped onto named rulers and used for authorship or chronology.
premortem_holds.appeal: Preserve the literary persona, parable, counsel, and proverb chains without historical identification.

premortem_holds.risk: English and MT versification are treated as competing authorities rather than mapped witnesses.
premortem_holds.appeal: Preserve the worship/vow discourse as one functional unit and retain the exact alternate reference mapping.

premortem_holds.risk: Gendered rhetoric is promoted as universal anthropology, author biography, or isolated moral verdict.
premortem_holds.appeal: Keep the difficult lines inside the failed wisdom-search movement, LOW confidence, with linguistic, ethical, and historical review requested.

premortem_holds.risk: Apparent contradictions are harmonized, ranked, or explained by speculative speakers/editors before the literary movements are preserved.
premortem_holds.appeal: Agreement is evidence only; retain tensions, larger units, exact alternatives, and append-only disagreement.

premortem_holds.risk: Later canonical reuse, reception, or a Genesis/Job/Proverbs parallel dictates an Ecclesiastes seam or preferred interpretation.
premortem_holds.appeal: Record relations separately as evidence-only; local form and discourse control this proposal.
